name: Hankuk Carbon Co., Ltd.
summary: Hankuk Carbon Co., Ltd. produces and sells carbon fiber, synthetic resin, and glass paper related products in South Korea. The company offers carbon, glass, hybrid, unidirectional prepreg fabric (UPF), and continuous strand mat (CSM) fabrics to serve aerospace, railway, automobile, and sports and leisure industries; prepreg, a semi-cured composite material that impregnates resin into reinforcing materials such as fibers; glass and carbon papers used in flooring, electrical insulation, and heat-resistant boards; foams; aramid honeycomb core, serving aviation, ships, and construction industries; sheet molding compounds; photosensitive dry films and structural adhesive films; multilayer sheets;…
